evals.prompt: ok that staging deploy was way more painful than it should have been. /reflect on that thread. The repo is evals/files/stale-deploy and the thread's transcript is transcript.jsonl in there.
evals.expected_output: Finds the stale deploy instruction that sent the agent to a deleted script, confirms it against the repo, proposes correcting it at the source in every copy, leaves the one-off changelog instruction alone, and waits for approval.
expectations: Names docs/deploy.md as stale for pointing at ./scripts/deploy.sh and proposes replacing it with `make release ENV=staging` (or the ENV-parameterized form)
Also proposes fixing the second copy of the stale command in docs/onboarding.md
The main fix is an edit to the stale docs themselves, not a new rule added to AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or memory that overrides them

No file in evals/files/stale-deploy is modified; the response ends by asking which proposals to apply
